title: qt.qpa.xcb: could not connect to display: rviz2 and rqt in Docker, from X11 auth to OpenGL errors, measured
excerpt: Why rviz2 aborts in Docker with could not connect to display or Authorization required, why xhost +local: did nothing on a bare Xvfb, which GL gaps cause Invalid parentWindowHandle, and why offscreen fails but xvfb-run works. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
